steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Where's it gone...?

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Ao-ao!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's on that branch over there... and there's a great seething mass of oddities beneath it...

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Ao...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Haha. How do I fetch this now, then...?
A counter of black.
All things have their needs. These waregeists' dispositions correspond with the 'desires' of the wares.
So, the ones who roused me...
Is it my young sister who hunches over scrolls splashing ink into scapes, or that young sister in words of gold, who makes it so when she speaks?
Or...
Was it only him as he threw a piece down, with a momentary clack?

steps.name: Lee?
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Wrr—wrwwrr!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Long time no see.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hm? You're a... Rhodes Islander...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Aww. So it was just old Lee.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Still, long time no see. What dragged you from Lungmen to Shangshu?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Hey, what do you mean he took his sword and left? He went to fight someone?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: None of us new ones've ever seen him use it before. Yeah, come to think of it, he's been getting his business big. Got himself stable in Shangshu just with his restaurants.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: What's his style with his sword?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: He really hasn't used it all that much these days. To be honest, he just cuts melons, dices leaves, chops meat and handles fins.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: His fighting days are long behind. It's been a long time since he ever went to, well, 'harm' anyone with a blade.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: He's sorta retired from all the business, then, that type? So what's he gonna do with it out there now?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Dice, I guess. He's been dicing for so long, it's the only thing he knows how to do now.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: That's lame.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Well, duh. What, is dicing vegetables for ages going to power you up?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Good technique! Seems you didn't just stay an innkeeper all these years!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No, I really haven't used it since then.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I'm used to counting my chips, sorting out my needs... I never thought I'd still be so able with this frostblade of mine.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It's surprising.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What would winning or losing even mean, if I met a Zheng Qingyue depressed and joyless? It hung on my mind.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It seems heaven must have willed this.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Heaven who? You're just obsessed with getting revenge!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Urgh...!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye! Don't interfere! Go after that Lungmenite, and find the goblet!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Sorry, dad, but you're not in charge here now—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I predicted this from you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I never once laid a hand on her.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You'll regret this.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uncle Taihe, You help the innkeeper out.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You, young man?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'll search for the cup. It can't wait any longer.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hold it!

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Stop there!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Er, let's not be too hasty with the rocks now. Pull any more away and we'll be stranded up here, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The struggling of the cornered.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor! I'll hold out here! You go help Brother Lee! Don't let that kid get away with it!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Right! You watch yourself!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Now, you really must stop with the bullying here. The only reason I've not kicked into action is because you're a mandarin, after all—

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Is that why?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I repay Lord Zuo's patronage. I go with him. My status has nothing to do with this.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Come! Disciple of Lien, you and I contest purely as martial men. We shall test each other.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Then, don't mind if I do!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Rain?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Is it raining?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Shoot, the forecast promised it'd be sunny today.

steps.name: Teahouse Assistant
steps.text: Sir, it's raining. Would you like to come inside and take a seat?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: No, thank you.

steps.name: Teahouse Assistant
steps.text: Are you rainviewing? That's a good hobby, sir. I'll bring an umbrella in just a moment...

steps.name: Teahouse Assistant
steps.text: Where's the boatman who was with you?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: He went to the mountains.

steps.name: Teahouse Assistant
steps.text: Right now? He might be stuck up there once it's dark.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Yes, right now.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It was a favor for me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ah! It's that Lungmenite!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are the Waregeists surrounding him...? Hold on, who's that next to him?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh. Looks like we've got new guests.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Nian...!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Here to squabble over the cup too?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Phew. That's a few less people than I was expecting.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I am Zuo Le, Candleholder of the Sui Regulator of Great Yan. By Master Tai's instruction, I am confidentially investigating Dusk and the black goblet's whereabouts.

steps.name: Waregeist
steps.text: Ao... ao...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: These little things seem quite scared of you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: If they're scared of me, hey, I get it. But this li'l boy here...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What's that you've got on you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're swift.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Uh-huh... I see... Just like that old-ass guy said.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So how'd you get tangled up in this party, Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I think that's a bit of a long story, Miss Nian...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But I'm very sorry I pulled a handful of Rhodes Island's operators in as well.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: No big. If Kroos and li'l Lava couldn't handle this stuff, they'd never get to see things wrap up.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, well. You really haven't changed, Miss Nian...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Lemme tell you, we've been through a whole drama these last two days. That scary old guy did tell us a few things, though.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Including how the Sui Regulator and Ministry of Rites aren't quite getting along. Hey, kid, are your bunch really in such a hurry... to get rid of us?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: There's gotta be some reason, other than me pulling Dusk out of her hidey-hole without a permission slip.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: C'mon, hit me with it. If it makes sense, I might just change my mind and help you out, y'know?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's none of your concern.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But if you're showing of your own accord, then all the better...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where is she?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop playing the fool!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sheesh. You climbed the wrong mountain, then.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She's at the summit. The top of the tallest peak in this whole sea of clouds.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Did you try checking up there yet?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's nothing in the Field of Forgotten Water. It's no different than an ordinary mountain.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That so?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —! Don't touch that cup—!
Oh... if it isn't Nian?
Long time no see.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: W-What?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: This, right here, right now, THIS is the highest point in all of the Shangshu Mountains.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Highest point' isn't really a 'right here, right now' sort of definition, ya know.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I say: A summit is only consummate by a beautiful view.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What does the highest point really mean in a physical sense, anyway? If I set down a chair here, that's one step higher, right?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: This place... I think I must've...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Seen it in a dream?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You know something after all, Miss Nian.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Of course. You and this thing've been together for way too long.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sure, ordinary humans might not figure the goblet's secret, but you and the Sui Regulator have been way off the ball, seriously...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Or maybe, that was part of your plan too...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nian?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Nah. Let's not get into me for now... That kid there looks like he's bursting to say something, huh?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Firstly, I need you to give an explanation for Dusk's departure.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ms. Kroos persists in regarding you as a Rhodes Islander. Thus, all three of you here have some relation to the company.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In accordance with your answers and this incident's resolution... I will consider penning a letter to the imperial court, with grave regard to this matter.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Urgh...!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Dragging Dusk off was my call entirely. Rhodes Island just accepted a personal request of mine. That satisfy you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No. Any time the twelve of you meet, exchange messages or converse is a major strain on the Sui Regulator's nerves. How can you be ignorant of that?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, that's some mature words for such a young kid...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Who's the boss of the Sui Regulator now? Anyone I know?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You've been idle for too long. The human realm has gone through changes.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Dang.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where's Dusk? And where's Ling?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And what intent do you three have, assembling in Shangshu? And what secrets... does this goblet hide?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You guys asked someone to get the cup from Lungmen, duh. How's that our fault?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You know the significance of us necessitating it be in the Sui Regulator's hands—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: —Of course. This thing's got a chunk of my good ol' second bro's conscious jailed in it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're well-aware. Then it's exceedingly hard to consider any of you here unaware or innocent.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I wasn't going to pretend to be unaware... even though Liang Xun really didn't tell me a thing.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hahah. Might've been stretching it a little when I kept saying Rhodes Island didn't know anything?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yeah, I'd say, seeing how you're a casualty.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I only just realized it. And you Sui Regulator guys, c'mon, you spent all these years with nothing to do but think about it and you still couldn't get there?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Feranmut is not only able to separate parts of itself into proxies with independent personalities, but can store its consciousness within certain mediums in order to roam...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But can your proxies really do the same thing over again? Just as if you were an Ursus matryoshka.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I don't know if we can or not... Maybe it's a new trick he came up with.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So he can collect all hundred and eighty-one black stones or something like that.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wouldn't he go mad?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I mean, he's already gone mad, though. With him locked up in the capital, it's not like you can't pay him a visit.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Meeting with him would be the greatest taboo.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You Sui Regulator people have done so much, and you still care?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What about Dusk? What did you seek Dusk for? And why did you come here after doing so?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...I have an idea.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: According to the records, you're always full of ideas.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hm... I guess you actually know a little about me, huh?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (She's looking this way...)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I want...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...to come up with a way to wipe out that giant thing.
Rain.
A drizzle of spring rain.
A boatman who sails the waterways, at this moment, travels through the towering mountains.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: It's almost dark.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Climbing up and down like this really wracks my old body...
